correctness.rationale: Gaussian heat equation and second-order integration by parts give a fully normalized exact mixed-moment formula. The center-projection contraction is an explicit polynomial; its rho=1/2 expression and all-n sign follow by elementary geometric sums and inequalities, n<=6 positivity from positive Bernstein coefficients, and positivity near rho=1 from projected distance vectors. The independent packaged verifier passed 204 finite exact identities. No claim of zero uniqueness, arbitrary distributions, or finite checks proving infinite cases.

value.rationale: This is a natural joint-dependence question for two routinely used diagnostics of correlated Gaussian signals: sign-crossing count and sample-demeaned dispersion. It shows a sharply located dimensional change from uniform positive covariance in windows up to six to a positive–negative–positive covariance pattern in every window of length at least seven, plus a negative extensive limit at fixed positive correlation. The exact finite-window boundary and limiting mechanism supply a genuine structural result, beyond a numerical or routine normalization check.
